- TOTAL revenue reached £64.7k in TW versus £45.7k in LW, a WoW change of +41.5%.
- TOTAL units came to 35,010 in TW, up 78.3% WoW, while TOTAL orders reached 1,777 in TW, up 20.2% WoW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led TW with £3,388.78, a 5.2% share of TOTAL TW revenue.
- WOODEN SKITTLES GARDEN SET took £2,650.90 in TW (4.1% share) and added £2,182.05 WoW.
- PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES posted £2,573.71 in TW (4.0% share) with the largest WoW gain of £2,531.08, followed by PACK OF 12 HEARTS DESIGN TISSUES at £2,504.11 in TW (3.9% share) and £2,463.64 WoW.
- WOODEN CROQUET GARDEN SET recorded £2,232.33 in TW, a 3.5% share, and rose 591.9% WoW.
- RETRO SPOT TEA SET CERAMIC 11 PC fell £1,734.02 WoW, REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER fell £1,239.60 WoW, and LUNCH BAG SUKI DESIGN fell £1,121.30 WoW.
- The top 5 products together held 20.6% of TOTAL TW revenue.
